abilities.name: Kamui Intangibility
abilities.desc: The first hit it takes in battle misses completely.

hidden.name: Six Paths Power
hidden.desc: Can't be burned, paralyzed, poisoned, put to sleep, frozen. Can't be confused (genjutsu doesn't take hold).

abilities.name: Endless Chakra
abilities.desc: Restores 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn. Can't be poisoned. Foes use 2 PP per move against it.

hidden.name: Ghost of the Uchiha
hidden.desc: Lowers the foes' Attack by 1 stage when it enters battle. Can't be intimidated.

abilities.name: Rinne-Sharingan Eyes
abilities.desc: Ignores the target's evasion boosts and its own accuracy drops. Can't be confused (genjutsu doesn't take hold). Can't be put to sleep. Its attacks hit a second time for 25% damage.

hidden.name: Moon's Eye
hidden.desc: On entry, casts a genjutsu that confuses a random foe. On entry, sets a Genjutsu Field for 5 turns (Yin moves 1.3x, no priority attacks on grounded shinobi).

abilities.name: Progenitor of Chakra
abilities.desc: Heals 1/8 of the damage its attacks deal. Can't be confused (genjutsu doesn't take hold).

hidden.name: Mother of Chakra
hidden.desc: Ignores its opponents' stat changes when attacking and being attacked. Restores 1/3 of its max HP when it switches out.

abilities.name: Lucky Seven
abilities.desc: Its moves' added effects are twice as likely.

hidden.name: Takigakure Spirit
hidden.desc: When a foe's attack misses it, its Speed rises by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Corrosive Bubbles
abilities.desc: Its attacks may lower the target's Defense by 1 stage (30%).

hidden.name: Bubble Barrier
hidden.desc: Takes 50% damage from Fire moves. Takes 50% damage from Lava moves.

abilities.name: Steam Armor
abilities.desc: Contact with it may cause burn (30%).

hidden.name: Steam Vents
hidden.desc: On entry, turns the sunlight harsh for 5 turns (Fire moves 1.5x, Water moves 0.5x). Kicking moves deal 1.2x damage.

abilities.name: Volcanic Body
abilities.desc: Can't be burned. Its Lava moves may cause burn (20%).

hidden.name: Old Monkey Wisdom
hidden.desc: Its Speed rises by 1 stage when it flinches. Each time it is hit, its Sp. Def rise by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Cat Reflexes
abilities.desc: Its Speed rises by 1 stage the first time it enters battle.

hidden.name: Blue Flames
hidden.desc: Fire moves deal 1.25x damage. Can't be burned.

abilities.name: Poison Sac
abilities.desc: Can't be poisoned. Its attacks may cause poison (20%).

hidden.name: Demigod of the Hidden Rain
hidden.desc: Poison heals it by 1/8 of its max HP each turn instead of hurting it. On entry, makes it rain for 5 turns (Water moves 1.5x, Fire moves 0.5x).

abilities.name: Protective Instinct
abilities.desc: When it switches out, the ally that comes in restores 1/6 of its max HP.

hidden.name: Academy Lessons
hidden.desc: At the end of each turn, may cure itself or an ally of a status condition (30%). Warns its team on entry if a foe has a super-effective move.

abilities.name: Will of Fire
abilities.desc: Deals 1.25x damage to shinobi with higher base stats than its own. Its moves deal 1.3x damage when it's the last shinobi standing on its team.

hidden.name: Honorable Grandson
hidden.desc: A foe of the opposite gender that makes contact with it may fall in love (50%).

abilities.name: Sealing Chains
abilities.desc: Its binding moves last longer and deal double damage. Deals 1.3x damage to Beast-type shinobi.

hidden.name: Red-Hot Habanero
hidden.desc: Each knockout raises its Attack and Speed by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Iai Master
abilities.desc: Slicing moves are more likely to land critical hits. Critical hits deal 2.25x damage instead of 1.5x.

hidden.name: Samurai Code
hidden.desc: Ignores its opponents' stat changes when attacking and being attacked. Its Speed rises by 1 stage when it flinches.

abilities.name: Gold Dust
abilities.desc: Its attacks may lower the target's Speed by 1 stage (30%).

hidden.name: Fourth Kazekage
hidden.desc: Weapon-type foes can't switch out while it's in battle.

abilities.name: Shisui of the Body Flicker
abilities.desc: Its first move after entering battle gets +1 priority. Its moves go through Substitutes and screens.

hidden.name: Shisui's Crow
hidden.desc: On entry, casts a genjutsu that confuses a random foe. Reflects status moves back at the user.

abilities.name: Tsunade's Apprentice
abilities.desc: Its healing moves restore 50% more HP. Its attacks may cause poison (20%).

hidden.name: Assistant's Care
hidden.desc: Its status condition is cured when it switches out. Restores 1/16 of its max HP each time it uses a status move.
